item.title: 0.12.0-beta.1
item.description:
Dosido 0.12.0-beta.1

Dosido now opens in its own window, so you can Command-Tab to it. A sidecar sits beside Ableton, Logic, Pro Tools or FL Studio and shows the track you're working on, with its to-dos, comments and check-out. Drop an audio file on either one to upload it. The menu bar features are unchanged. ⌘Q now closes Dosido's windows; Quit is in the menu bar menu.

Dosido 0.11.4

  • Open a version's session folder from the web. When you're looking at a version on dosido.app, the File panel shows "Session · Open folder". Click it and Finder opens the Ableton, Logic, Pro Tools or FL Studio session it was bounced from. Note: this is only available for bounces you make from now on.
  • Fixed: Finder now comes to the front when you open a session folder from the web.
  • Bug fixes and improvements.
